# Saugumo politika / Security policy

## Lietuviškai

Radote G-Procure saugumo spragą? Praneškite neviešai:

- per GitHub - [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/Jurgelaitis/g-procure/security/advisories/new) (pranešimą mato tik G-Procure teikėjas);
- arba el. paštu [arunas.jurgelaitis@litgrid.eu](mailto:arunas.jurgelaitis@litgrid.eu?subject=G-Procure%20-%20saugumo%20spraga), tema „G-Procure - saugumo spraga“.

Saugumo spragoms nenaudokite viešų „Issues“ ir spragos neviešinkite, kol ji neištaisyta.
Pranešimo gavimą patvirtiname per 5 darbo dienas.

- Taisyklės, apimtis ir sąžiningas tyrimas: <https://g-procure.com/saugumas.html>
- Kompiuterio skaitomas kontaktas (RFC 9116): <https://g-procure.com/.well-known/security.txt>
- Palaikoma versija: tik dabartinė svetainės `g-procure.com` versija (šaka `main`).

## English

Found a security vulnerability in G-Procure? Report it privately:

- via GitHub - [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/Jurgelaitis/g-procure/security/advisories/new) (only the G-Procure provider sees the report);
- or by email to [arunas.jurgelaitis@litgrid.eu](mailto:arunas.jurgelaitis@litgrid.eu?subject=G-Procure%20-%20security%20vulnerability) with the subject “G-Procure - security vulnerability”.

Do not use public issues for vulnerabilities, and do not disclose a vulnerability until it is fixed.
We acknowledge receipt within 5 working days.

- Rules, scope and good-faith research: <https://g-procure.com/saugumas.html?lang=en>
- Machine-readable contact (RFC 9116): <https://g-procure.com/.well-known/security.txt>
- Supported version: only the current version of the `g-procure.com` site (branch `main`).
